description: Publish a new version of a business profile as a signed envelope. Prove the domain with TXT _humancollab.<domain> = humancollab-business=<public_key>, or serve that line at https://<domain>/.well-known/humancollab.txt. Optional payload.change_note explains what was corrected.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, raw 32 bytes, base64

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload, base64

name: submit_business_profile
title: Submit business profile
